environment.cloud: Disposable real Control and Artifact Workers, WorkspaceHub, D1 and R2
environment.browser: Headless Chromium; compiled ReviewPanel, production session/CSRF routes and actual isolated preview bytes

regressions.changed_retry_baseline: A changed note under the original request key returned the cached private decision.
regressions.revoked_retry_baseline: Project access removal did not fence the cached private reply.
regressions.audit_baseline: Generic Hub receipts copied review notes into semantic, audit and outbox payloads.
regressions.current: Current authority precedes cache lookup; exact input fingerprints reject changed retries; Hub receipts and review-audit dispatch contain metadata only.

browser_boundaries.loaded_preview: Actual hostile HTML remains in the V02 sandbox while the compiled review controls record inert notes and explicit decisions.
browser_boundaries.immutability: Review binds exact version/hash, survives reload and becomes historical after publication; a new version needs its own explicit approval.
browser_boundaries.conflict: Publication before decision returns stale_version and reload recovers to the new unapproved version.
browser_boundaries.authority: Cookie loss denies a draft decision; project revocation denies cached replies and private reads without leaking the note.
browser_boundaries.business_separation: Review actions do not change task/run/launch/result records. Explicit timer start/stop produces two A04 observations, not browser activity.
browser_boundaries.audit_dispatch: Concurrent dispatch of one committed review source produces one bounded metadata projection.

upgrade_limit: Historical cache records without input fingerprints fail closed; immutable canonical review history remains readable under current authority.
not_claimed: Persistent pilot enablement, deployment or live provider execution
Whole-board redesign, theme support, private-task ACLs, project knowledge, catalogs or business secrets
Production static-asset routing: the compiled fixture bundle uses a synthetic HTTP bridge; business/auth/Hub/D1/R2 paths use real Workers
redaction: Bounded synthetic assertions and counts only; no credentials, private content, machine paths or raw output retained. Historical evidence is unchanged.
